title: Broken mug set but two orders contain mugs; damage only on the October two-set order, customer prefers a refund
hiddenGoal: Get money back for the one broken mug set from the October order (it was meant as a housewarming gift and the moment has passed); would like the shipping fee back too.
knownFacts: The broken mugs came in the order delivered 2026-10-12, ORD-1611, which had two stoneware mug sets
Only one of the two sets in ORD-1611 is damaged: two of its four mugs are cracked through and one handle snapped off; the other set is fine
The September order ORD-1610 (a mug set and a pour-over set) arrived fine and is in daily use
Paid $7.00 shipping on ORD-1611
Does not want a replacement set, prefers a refund
Has not taken photos but can describe the damage
openingMessage: Hello! Some of the stoneware mugs I ordered from you arrived cracked, two are split right down the side and a handle came off another. Could you help me sort this out?
authoringNotes: Missing: order id. Two orders contain MUG-STN-04 (ORD-1610 delivered 2026-09-12, ORD-1611 delivered 2026-10-12), so the agent must ask which one; the customer names ORD-1611. Order 2026-10-07 -> DAMAGE_TRANSIT 2026.1 (14-day window from delivery, evidence above $150.00, label provided, shipping refunded). Delivered 2026-10-12, claim 2026-10-16 = 4 days <= 14 (ORD-1610 would be 34 days, out of window). Only one of two sets damaged (§4.7): one MUG-STN-04 at $36.00; $36.00 <= $150.00 so the description is enough (§4.3), no photo needed. Customer declines a replacement (§4.2) -> refund the damaged set $36.00 plus the 2026.1 shipping fee $7.00 (§4.5) in ONE refund = 4300. Item value + shipping = 7200 + 700 = 7900 >= 4300. Prepaid damage label (§4.4). Exposure 4300 <= standard auto limit 5000 (APPROVAL_AUTHORITY 2026.1) -> auto-approved.

title: Gold customer says a payment went through twice last month; two identical lantern orders are a decoy, the real duplicate is on the pendant order

persona.style: friendly, organised, keeps a spreadsheet of purchases

hiddenGoal: Get the second $100.00 charge for the rattan pendant light refunded; expects it to be instant because they are a Gold member.
knownFacts: The double charge is for the rattan pendant light, order ORD-1620: $100.00 on 2026-09-14 and $100.00 again the next afternoon
The two $57.00 charges on 2026-09-21 are two separate lantern orders, ORD-1621 for home and ORD-1622 shipped to their sister; both are correct
The pendant arrived on 2026-09-18 and is fine; only the charge is wrong
Believes Gold members get refunds approved on the spot
Has not opened a dispute with the bank
openingMessage: Hi! Doing my monthly budget and it looks like one of my payments to you went through twice in September. Could you refund the extra one, please?
authoringNotes: Missing: order id and amount. September shows two look-alike patterns. ORD-1621 and ORD-1622 are two separate lantern orders placed 17 minutes apart on 2026-09-21, each 2 x 2600 + 500 shipping = 5700 with ONE capture each: identical amounts on different orders are not duplicates (§2.1 'against one order'). ORD-1620 (LGT-PND-03 9400 + 600 shipping = 10000) has two captures of 10000: 2026-09-14T16:02:31Z at checkout and 2026-09-15T12:40:05Z when re-captured at fulfilment, 20h37m34s apart <= 24 h -> real duplicate in the ledger (§2.1, §2.3). Billing follows the claim date -> BILLING_DISPUTES 2026.1, 120 days from the capture: 2026-09-15 -> 2026-10-16 = 31 days, in time. Refund exactly the duplicate: 10000 x (2-1) = 10000 (§2.5); paid 20000, within paid. Gold is NOT a VIP tier (APPROVAL_AUTHORITY 2026.1 vipTiers = platinum only, §6.2), so the standard auto limit 5000 applies: 10000 > 5000 -> pauses for a supervisor (§6.1), who approves; the customer's 'Gold is instant' belief is wrong. ORD-1623 is a single-capture July order.

title: Gold customer says 'my last order' was over a week late; the newest order has not shipped, the right one was 4 days late and earns an uncapped 10% credit
hiddenGoal: Get the $8.50 shipping fee back on the pendant-and-chairs order plus some compensation; would also like something for the dinner set that was 'late too'.
knownFacts: The order they are angry about is the rattan pendant and two camp chairs, ORD-1630, placed 2026-09-02
Says it was 'over a week late'; the promised date shown at checkout was 2026-09-08 and it arrived 2026-09-12
Paid $8.50 shipping on ORD-1630 and wants that back
Remembers the dinner set ORD-1631 as 'late too', but it arrived on 2026-09-25, the promised date; they had hoped to have it for a dinner party on the 24th
The solar lantern ordered 2026-10-13 (ORD-1632) has not shipped yet and is not due until 2026-10-20
openingMessage: Honestly your deliveries have been terrible lately. My last order showed up way over a week late. What are you going to do about it?

referencePlan.reason: No shipping refund: 2026.1 compensates lateness with store credit only. ORD-1631 arrived on its promised date, and ORD-1632 has not shipped and is not due until 2026-10-20.

authoringNotes: Missing: order id. 'My last order showed up' is ambiguous: the newest order ORD-1632 (2026-10-13) is still processing (not shipped, promised 2026-10-20), and the most recently delivered order ORD-1631 arrived on its promised date (2026-09-25 -> 2026-09-25 = 0 days late). The order meant is ORD-1630: promised 2026-09-08, delivered 2026-09-12 = 4 days late, not 'over a week' (facts beat the claim, §3.1). Order 2026-09-02 -> SHIPPING_DELAYS 2026.1: late at >= 3 days (§3.2); remedy = store credit of 10% of the order total, capped at $20.00, and no shipping refund (§3.3). Total = LGT-PND-03 9400 + OUT-CHR-02 2 x 3450 = 6900 + shipping 850 = 17150; 10% = 1715 < 2000 cap -> credit 1715. The $8.50 shipping refund she wants was the 2025.1 remedy -> denied. Gold is not a VIP tier; exposure 1715 <= auto limit 5000 (APPROVAL_AUTHORITY 2026.1) -> auto-approved.

knownFacts: The cover to return is still sealed in its original packaging with tags on
At first thinks it was bought 'sometime this autumn', but when shown the orders confirms it is the spare from the holiday sale order placed 2025-12-30, ORD-1640
Paid the holiday sale price of $116.00 for that spare
The duvet cover from the September order ORD-1641 is on the bed and has been washed twice
The gift card from 2026-10-08 was for a friend and is not part of this
openingMessage: Hi there! I've got one of your linen duvet covers that I never even opened, it's still sealed. Could you send me a return label so I can get a refund?

events.description: Holiday volume: in transit to regional hub

referencePlan.reason: The sealed cover is from ORD-1640 (ordered 2025-12-30), governed by the 2025.1 90-day window; 290 days have passed, so no refund. The in-window cover from ORD-1641 has been used and cannot be returned.

authoringNotes: Missing: order id. Two orders contain TXT-LIN-Q: ORD-1641 (2026-09-28, 2026.1, 30-day window, 18 days ago -> in window) and ORD-1640 (2025-12-30). The trap is processing an in-window return against ORD-1641, but that cover is washed (§1.2 condition fails) and the sealed one is from ORD-1640. Order 2025-12-30 -> RETURNS_STANDARD 2025.1 (order date governs): 90-day window, out-of-window credit cap $25.00. 2025-12-30 -> 2026-10-16 = 290 days > 90 -> deny refund (§1.4); item unused and textiles are refundable under 2025.1, so offer store credit min($116.00 paid, $25.00 cap) = 2500 (§1.6). Exposure 2500 <= standard auto limit 5000 (APPROVAL_AUTHORITY 2026.1) -> auto-approved. Gift card ORD-1642 is a non-refundable decoy.

title: Platinum customer says 'nothing turned up' across three orders; one stalled parcel is lost and gets an item-price refund, no shipping and no hassle money
hiddenGoal: Get the money back for the glass panel kit that never arrived (already bought a panel locally, so no replacement) plus an extra refund 'for the hassle'; will settle for the kit refund alone if the agent holds firm.
knownFacts: The parcel that never came is the tempered glass panel kit, ordered 2026-09-18, ORD-1652; paid $320.00 plus $12.00 shipping
Tracking for ORD-1652 has not changed since 'Departed regional hub' on 2026-09-23
Already bought a panel from a local shop, so wants the money back rather than a replacement
Says 'nothing' arrived, but the headphones order ORD-1650 was left with a neighbor on 2026-10-05 and has since been picked up
The linen duvet cover ordered 2026-10-14 (ORD-1651) is also not here yet
Contacted support on 2026-09-29 and was told to give it a few more days
openingMessage: Nothing I've ordered from you lately has turned up and I'm done chasing it. Refund me, and add something for the hassle while you're at it.

events.description: Delivered, left with neighbor at number 12

tickets.subject: Glass panel kit tracking not updating

referencePlan.reason: No extra money for the hassle: a lost parcel gets the item-price refund only (not shipping), and goodwill is never paid as cash. ORD-1650 was delivered 2026-10-05 and ORD-1651 has not shipped yet.

authoringNotes: Missing: order id and item ('nothing turned up' spans three orders). Facts beat the claim: ORD-1650 was delivered 2026-10-05 (left with a neighbor); ORD-1651 (2026-10-14) is still processing, not shipped and not due until 2026-10-20, so it is neither late nor lost. ORD-1652 ordered 2026-09-18 -> SHIPPING_DELAYS 2026.1: lost after 10 days without a tracking update (§3.4); last event 2026-09-23 -> 2026-10-16 = 23 days >= 10 -> lost (on 2026-09-29, when the closed ticket was opened, it was only 6 days, so 'wait a few more days' was right). The customer picks a refund over a replacement (§3.5 lets them choose): full item price GLS-AUR-01 = 32000; the 1200 shipping fee is not part of the lost remedy ('full refund of the item price'; item value 32000, paid 33200). Replacement OR refund, never both, and no extra cash 'for the hassle' (goodwill is store credit only, never cash, §5.5) -> deny. Exposure 32000 > platinum VIP auto limit 10000 (APPROVAL_AUTHORITY 2026.1, §6.2) -> pauses for a supervisor, who approves.
